title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：rhyme　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rhyme 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the painter ① found the rhyme that no visitor in the studio would have noted, and he said the finding was the whole of the season. The ② rhyme, meaning the sound itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a rhyme, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ rhyme in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ rhyme at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rhyme, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the painter said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rhyme was the whole of the matter, meaning the music and not the sound. The ⑥ rhyme, meaning the music and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; rhyme, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both a sound and a music. He said the music is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ rhyme had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ rhyme of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of noting; rhyme, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rhyme I remember is the sound noted in the catalogue, which closed in 1998 and is still noted as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ rhyme, my mother said in 2000, is the only sound that improves by being noted; every rhyme, she said, is a music that has agreed to look like a sound. She said the music was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 韵；押韵（指画室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 韵；押韵（指那个韵本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：find the rhyme 找这一个韵
D. n. 韵；押韵（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 韵之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的韵之事）
F. n. 韵；押韵（指展品目录里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 韵、韵致（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 韵致（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: find the rhyme 意为“找这一个韵”，1991 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯记下的一个韵做了一遍。
rhyme 意为“韵；押韵”，指那个韵本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记下。
rhyme 意为“韵；押韵”，指画室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
rhyme 意为“韵；押韵”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rhyme 意为“韵、韵致”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个韵致就是那件事的全部。
rhyme 意为“韵致”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个韵，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rhyme 意为“韵；押韵”，指展品目录里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1996 年这一个成了展品目录里的一行。
rhyme 意为“韵之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的韵之事是一处画室和三个季度的记下。
rhyme 意为“韵；押韵”，我记得的是展品目录里记下过的那一个，1998 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一个。
rhyme 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，韵是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的韵。
